text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey there!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for joining us for our first shrine visit of the year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of us head to a shrine so Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black can start off the new year by conveying their passionate wishes to the divine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm… I don't know what to wish for.
choice_data_list: Don't you want to win the Classic Triple Crown?
Don't you want to win the Classic Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, but that's something I need to accomplish myself, not something I should ask the divine to intercede with.
choice_data_list: How about praying to break your family's jinx?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll break that myself with my own strength!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: See? This is why I can never think of what to pray for. I find myself stumped every year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking that into consideration, I suggest she simply declare her goal for the year instead.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What a wonderful idea! I won't be able to back down once I make it official!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This won't simply be a prayer for victory, but an oath for victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears she's going to make an incredibly weighty pledge.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What should I make my goal for the year, though? It seems too obvious to simply aim for the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: How should I run as a member of the Satono family? As someone who aspires to be an illustrious runner?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (How do I envision myself?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (And what I should devote greater attention to?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to run with pride and dignity.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to run with my head held high like McQueen, and stand proudly before everyone as a representative of the Satono family.
choice_data_list: That's a great goal. It's very true to yourself.
That's a great goal. It's very true to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To run with the elegance of a diamond—a goal only one raised from a young age to be an elite runner would have.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It looks like you've made up your mind too, Kita. Then come on, let's go pray!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I want to perform well in the senior Spring Triple Crown and receive a lot of support! And I want to make everyone smile!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win the Classic Triple Crown! As an Umamusume of the Satono family, I vow to put on a dazzling performance on the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although they're entering different races, they have the same glimmer in their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's as if they'll be running in parallel until the fateful day when their paths cross. I feel the strength of their childhood bond.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe! People are slowly starting to take notice of me, so I'm gonna run as best as I can to get more fans!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my. Unfortunately for you, I plan to captivate everyone with running that's just as dazzling as the jewel I'm named after.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmph! That won't matter if I steal all their hearts first at the Senior Spring Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Grrr… Then I'll simply turn the tables once again at the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Rrrrgh! Victory shall be mine! Hnngh! I'm gonna win this for sure!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this with a New Year's showdown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There's no need to worry, Trainer. A New Year's contest is an annual event for us.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's the perfect way to settle things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both of them are becoming quite heated and show no signs of calling this off. But if they do this every year, then I suppose there's no danger…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's have Trainer decide our competition!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Fine by me! Be sure to pick something we can really go all out in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to think of a no-holds-barred competition that seems appropriate for New Year's.
choice_data_list: See who can cheer best for the relay race!
See who can collect the most mochi at a mochi-tossing event!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you mean the New Year's Relay Race, right? Let's see… They should be passing by here any moment!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All right, it's a cheering contest, then! Trainer, you be the judge!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, I can see the front of the pack coming up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: COME OOON! Make a break from the back and steal the lead! It's time to push through!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You can do it! You're catching up! Yes, that's it! Keep up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The leading contenders sprint past us in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right, let's head to the next checkpoint!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's up at the top of the mountain, right? Okay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The uphill section is tough for everyone! Hang in there! Don't give up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You've got to keep it together! Don't push yourself too hard! Just go at your own pace!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's move to the next spot!
choice_data_list: Hold on! How far are we—

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: THIS IS THE LAST STRETCH! YOU CAN DO IIIT!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Aaand both teams cross the finish line at nearly the same time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was fun! I worked up a good sweat!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That was more exciting than I thought it would be! Well, Trainer? Who do you think cheered the best?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Well, at least I don't need to worry about gaining any holiday weight.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mochi-tossing?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The shrine staff throw mochi cakes to visitors during New Year's! Whoever collects the most wins, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see! So we just need to pick up as many as we can!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Staff
text_block_list.text: Here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It looks like there's gonna be a bunch over there! You're miiine!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's going on? Eek!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: O-oh no, I got pushed out… The Umamusume and the human areas are both so packed…
choice_data_list: Look on the ground behind you,

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone's so focused on the mochi the staff are tossing, nobody notices the ones that have fallen out of reach or haven't been picked up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh wow! There are so many back there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm going to grab them all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I got tons of mochi!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What a haul! ♪ Let's head back and whip up some red bean soup with these!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We buy some adzuki beans on the way back to campus, and then the three of us fill our bellies with some tasty mochi soup.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a bite competition? Are we going to see who can eat more food?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Erm… I think you misheard, Dia. It's a kite competition, not a bite competition.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oops, I guess I'm hungrier than I thought. But okay! I've seen kite flying competitions on TV before! It seems fun!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll fly my kite over there first! Since you suggested this, you be the judge, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Satono Diamond has almost no experience flying a kite, I show her the ropes—or rather, the kite strings.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm, I see. So you control the string like that… and anticipate the wind direction during the run-up…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haaah! …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Weird… It won't catch the wind and go up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm up next!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond jogs a little and manages to get her kite airborne. She watches the wind direction carefully and skillfully catches the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're so good at this! Okay, I can do it too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Here we gooo! Ah! It's up! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's about time! The contest starts now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond employs theory and technique while Kitasan Black utilizes her enthusiasm and perseverance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their kite-flying styles are a perfect reflection of their personalities, and both kites soar majestically in the sky above.
